title: Repository Validation
purpose: Defines the repository validation component that evaluates conformance of the staged or promoted repository.

normative_requirements.text: The repository validation component shall validate the staged or promoted repository against declared conformance requirements, structural constraints, and repository-specification rules.

The repository validation component shall produce a validation report that lists each check, its result, and any details required to diagnose failures, and shall not report overall success when any required check fails.
